title: Frontend: Project overview tab — vision, stats, recent activity summary
description: The Overview tab shows the project vision, key stats (progress, points, level), and a summary of recent activity.
acceptanceCriteria: Vision/description displayed in a card (with placeholder if empty)
Stats section: progress bar (auto + manual), points total, level badge, milestone completion rate
Recent activity: last 5 timeline events as a mini timeline
Quick actions: 'Log Update' button (opens journal entry dialog), 'Add Todo' button

steps.details: Create src/components/project/tabs/OverviewTab.tsx. Accept project as prop. Layout: 2-column on desktop (vision + stats on left, recent activity on right). Single column on mobile.

Display project.description in a Card with edit button (pencil icon) that opens an inline edit form. If no description, show placeholder text 'No vision statement yet. Add one to keep your project focused.'
Progress bar with label showing auto% and manual% (if set). Milestones: 'X of Y completed'. Points and level. All in a Card grid.
Fetch GET /api/projects/:id/timeline?limit=5. Render each event as a compact row: icon + event description + time ago.
Open overview tab. Verify vision, stats, and recent activity render. Add a journal entry — verify it appears in recent activity. Edit vision inline — verify it saves.
